en.loginDescription: Sign in to your DeepSeek account or add an API Key to get started. Your projects and files are stored locally.
en.modelSignInRequired: Model unavailable. Please sign in and try again.
en.onboardingCompactDescription: See just the results in a clean, simple interface
en.onboardingCreditDescription: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.
en.onboardingDetailedDescription: See the full process for easier debugging and troubleshooting
en.onboardingDevelopmentDescription: Edit code, debug issues, run commands, manage project files, and more
en.onboardingIntroduction: DeepSeek Harness works in a local folder and uses tools to read and write files on your computer. It can help you research and organize information, create documents and spreadsheets, write code, troubleshoot issues, and more.
en.onboardingNoCreditDescription: DeepSeek Harness can’t start new tasks without credits. You can add them later in Settings → Account.
en.onboardingOfficeDescription: Edit documents, organize data, create presentations, and more
en.onboardingProcess: How much detail would you like to see?
en.onboardingProcessDescription: This only changes how progress is shown, not what DeepSeek Harness can do.
en.onboardingPurposeDescription: We’ll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.
en.onboardingSaveFailed: Could not save settings. Try again.
en.onboardingSkipDescription: You can change how progress, performance, and usage are displayed, or enable Coding Tools, anytime in Settings → General.
en.onboardingStandardDescription: Focus on results, with only the most important steps and actions shown
en.platformFailed: Could not complete the operation. Try again.
en.profileUnavailable: Account details are not available yet.
en.quotaDescription: DeepSeek Harness cannot start a new task with this account when no balance is available. Would you like to top up? You can also top up later in Settings → Account.
en.sessionExpired: You have signed out of your account, please log in again.
en.settingsSignedOutDescription: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness to get your dedicated API Key
en.settingsSignedOutTitle: You are not signed in to DeepSeek Harness
en.signInDescription: Use your DeepSeek account to get started.
en.signOutDescription: Signing out will not delete any data. You can sign in to this account again.
en.signOutRunningDescription: Tasks are currently running. Signing out will interrupt them. Sign out now?
en.signOutUnknownDescription: Could not check running tasks. Signing out may interrupt tasks using this account. Sign out now?

zh.loginDescription: 登录 DeepSeek 账号，或添加 API Key，即可开始使用。你的项目和文件保存在本地。
zh.modelSignInRequired: 当前模型暂不可用，请登录后再试
zh.onboardingCompactDescription: 只看结果，保持界面简洁明了
zh.onboardingCreditDescription: DeepSeek Harness 执行任务时，会根据模型与工具使用的 token 量扣除额度。请提前添加额度，避免任务在执行过程中被迫中断。你的余额只会在 Agent 实际执行任务时消耗。
zh.onboardingDetailedDescription: 查看完整工作过程，方便调试和排查问题
zh.onboardingDevelopmentDescription: 修改代码、调试问题、运行命令和管理项目文件等
zh.onboardingIntroduction: DeepSeek Harness 会以本地文件夹作为工作区，通过调用各种工具，读写本机文件，完成搜索整理资料、制作文档表格、编写代码、排查问题等各种任务。
zh.onboardingNoCreditDescription: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 将无法开始新的任务。你可以稍后前往 设置 → 账号与余额 进行充值。
zh.onboardingOfficeDescription: 编辑文档、整理数据和制作演示文稿等
zh.onboardingProcess: 你希望看到多少工作过程？
zh.onboardingProcessDescription: 这只会影响工作过程的展示方式，不会影响 DeepSeek Harness 的工作能力。
zh.onboardingPurposeDescription: 我们会根据你的选择调整界面和工具，以更适合你的工作方式。
zh.onboardingSkipDescription: 你可以随时前往 设置 → 通用设置 中调整工作过程、性能与用量展示方式或开启代码工作工具。
zh.onboardingStandardDescription: 结果优先，仅展示重要步骤和关键操作
zh.quotaDescription: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 无法开始新的任务，是否前往充值？或者可以稍后前往 设置 → 账号与余额 进行充值。
zh.sessionExpired: 登录信息已失效，请重新登录
zh.settingsSignedOutDescription: 登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号获取专属 API Key
zh.settingsSignedOutTitle: 当前未登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号
zh.signInDescription: 登录 DeepSeek 账号以开始使用
zh.signOutDescription: 退出登录不会丢失任何数据，你仍可以登录此账号。
zh.signOutRunningDescription: 当前有进程正在执行中，点击“退出登录”，将会打断进程，是否即刻退出登录？
zh.signOutUnknownDescription: 暂时无法确认任务状态。退出登录可能会中断使用此账号的任务，是否继续？
zh.timeoutDescription: 请重新登录后继续操作。
